inherited.primary: B0-EMA, K=2, identity history, R4 unavailable; student is the only gradient receiver.

repair.defect: Float32 network VJP component-sum error trips the frozen decomposition tolerance despite additive probability-leaf derivatives; same-draw FP64 reference supported on both GPUs.
repair.native_path: Keep original float32 student/teacher forwards and their grad modes, official 3x3 classifier, stochastic draws, logits/features, PAS, reliability and cached teacher outputs.
repair.shadow_path: Deep-copy the frozen student into float64; keep original class/parameter names and all inactive parameters; no original or teacher conversion.
repair.same_draw: Capture each original student torch.randn_like result without changing its return or RNG; replay those float32 Gaussian values cast to float64 in the corresponding shadow forward, with no RNG advance.
repair.losses: Use unchanged supervised mean CE and all unchanged pixel-normalized/class-balanced consistency objectives and class decompositions, now differentiated on the shared float64 shadow graph.
repair.teacher_and_poe_targets: Canonicalize gradient targets using the original float32 conversion before casting to float64; class strata must equal original float32 argmax. PoE reporting/probability arrays retain their existing independent precision and formula.
repair.native_control: Compute native float32 total gradients for every same-input objective and labeled CE as an engineering precision control. No native class decomposition is bypassed to declare an old run successful; the old native mode and its guard remain unchanged. The new control is not an admission source or a fallback.
repair.off_switch: Default native execution must remain output-equivalent to the frozen engine on synthetic full-phase tests; no training flags are enabled.
repair.exception_audit: Run model/teacher/legacy/current/history isolation checks also when a probe raises, recording original exceptions and preserving occupied output.
repair.code_policy: Reuse execution.py and gradients.py; share already-tested replay/RNG/comparison helpers in precision.py, and import them in the old forensic helper without changing its calculations. Do not change training, modeling, reliability, metrics, reporting, frozen input contracts or scientific gates.

pilot.selection_rule: Previously registered stage0 integration pair, recovered-input stage1 integration pair, and the sole previously failed stage2 pair. Selected for stage/engineering coverage, not scientific scores.
pilot.phase_barrier: All three pilot pairs and audits must finish a phase before any worker starts the next phase.

precision_comparability.both_exact_zero: Precision control agrees, but alignment cosine stays null and cannot satisfy a scientific required comparison.
precision_comparability.required_for: Every global total-objective gradient and every global labeled gradient, not an average or a selected candidate.

acceptance.native_golden: Student logits/features, labeled logits, native supervised gradient and all eight draw0 total-gradient hashes must equal the two original golden receipts; the failed pair's available forward/target/weight and native R2-class-balanced hash must equal its forensic receipt.
acceptance.fp64_golden: Failed pair draw0 R2/class-balanced global hash must match the independently published FP64 reference.
acceptance.PAS: Per-pixel R1 must equal the unchanged Gate0 pas_probability_objective on all native scoring calls.
invariants: same native forwards across candidates and phases
same shadow forwards across candidates and phases
exact teacher draw seeds and cache identities
no model/buffer/GAS/bank/RNG mutation by the shadow
all source and shadow parameter.grad fields None and teacher frozen
all nine original checkpoints and frozen provenance unchanged
all expected pairs/phases/rows/guards and no extra units

outcome_policy: Only complete passing engineering evidence can yield PASS_NUMERIC_PRECISION_PILOT; numeric-comparability failures, protocol failures and partial evidence are preserved, never dropped or repaired by selecting a candidate/device. No scientific Gate1C verdict from three pairs. After both workers and all phases finish, publish all evidence and a finite next plan; any full diagnostic needs its own prospective execution/retention authorization.
